one_month_reasoning: No AAOI-specific scheduled event falls inside 2026-10-02 to 2026-11-01: Q3 2026 results are expected around Nov 5 (estimated date, src 6/7 context), just after the window. In-window drivers are hyperscaler Q3 capex prints in the last week of October (MSFT/GOOGL/META/AMZN), which move the whole AI-optics group, plus ongoing sales under the $600M ATM (src 4,5) that cap rallies, and pre-earnings run-up behaviour (the stock rose into the last two prints). The stock bounced 14% in the final week of September, so short-term momentum/reversal roughly cancel. I therefore centre the 1-month distribution essentially on spot (median ~$114.5, a hair below spot for ATM supply) with lognormal sigma 0.36, close to the 139%/3.5 rule-of-thumb monthly vol, and do not take a directional view.

fair_value.method: Blend of P/E (60%): NTM-at-Oct-2027 EPS $5.00 x 22x = $110, and EV/EBITDA (40%): NTM EBITDA $570M x 17x + ~$0.6B net cash over ~102M diluted shares = $101; blended ~$106.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS at Oct-2027 $5.00 x 22x forward P/E

inputs_detail.derivation: Consensus $4.60 haircut ~15% for AAOI's history of execution/customer shocks (2017 Amazon cut, 2018-19 and 2025 drawdowns) and margin pressure from ramp costs.
~+40% on 2027, consistent with capacity rising from 650k to 930k units/month by end-2027 and a larger 1.6T ramp in 2027 per management.

Inside the 11-peer range (15.8x-62.4x, median 37.7x); set between the closest product peers InnoLight 15.8x / Eoptolink 18.7x and Fabrinet 25.5x, because AAOI has lower gross margin (~30% vs peers), heavy customer concentration and serial equity dilution.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: NTM revenue $2.6B x 22% EBITDA margin = $570M x 17x = $9.7B EV + $0.6B net cash; /102M diluted shares

inputs_detail.derivation: FY26 ~$1.1B less Q2 $191.9M and Q3 midpoint ~$272M implies Q4 2026 ~$450-500M (~$1.9B run rate); capacity +43% through 2027 (650k to 930k units/month) supports ~$2.6B NTM if demand holds.
Non-GAAP gross margin guide 29-30.5% less opex ~11-12% of sales at scale plus D&A ~4%.
Near the estimated forward EV/EBITDA of closest pure-play transceiver peers (InnoLight ~17.5x, Eoptolink ~17.3x) and below the 11-peer median ~29x for the same quality reasons as the P/E discount.
Cash $500M and debt $300M (src 6) plus ~$600M ATM proceeds (src 4) less ~$0.2B net capex burn over the ramp.
92.8M diluted used in Q3 guidance + ~5.5M ATM shares at ~$110 + remaining Amazon warrant vesting/other ~4M.

bear.story: 2017/2025 replay: a large hyperscaler customer digests or dual-sources 800G/1.6T, InnoLight/Eoptolink take share, gross margin slips below 25%, and more dilution; 2027 EPS ~$1.5-2 at a peer-low multiple. AAOI's own history: after every prior +100% year it fell 27-62% the next year in 2017-18, and it has averaged -44% peak-to-trough in market shocks.

base.story: Capacity ramp largely delivered but with slippage; 2027 revenue ~$2.0-2.4B, EPS ~$3.5-4.5, multiple compresses toward the transceiver pure-play range (~20-25x NTM) as growth normalises; stock roughly flat.

bull.story: Demand outruns supply through 2027 as management says, 930k units/month reached, 1.6T ramp drives Q4-2027 run rate above $3B and EPS run-rate $8+; market keeps ~27-30x, revisiting the May-2026 high area.

Forward EV/EBITDA is estimated from trailing EV/EBITDA divided by (1 + 3Y EPS growth consensus) because forward EBITDA was not available on the free source.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: 22x NTM P/E and 17x EV/EBITDA: below the peer median and inside the range, between the two closest product peers (InnoLight 15.8x, Eoptolink 18.7x) and Fabrinet (25.5x). AAOI itself trades at ~50x NTM and ~25x CY27 consensus EPS today (src 6,7).
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: Discount to the broad peer median, not a premium: the higher-multiple peers (ALAB, MRVL, CRDO, LITE) are fabless/IP or laser-component businesses with 50-70% gross margins, while AAOI is a 30%-gross-margin module assembler with high customer concentration (over half of revenue from one customer in 2017; Amazon warrant tie-up since 2025) and three equity raises in 2026. Its closest operational peers (InnoLight, Eoptolink) trade at 16-19x despite larger scale and higher margins, so no premium can be argued to persist.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$65 (under the July-2026 low of $76 and ~13x my NTM EPS) the market would be pricing 2027 EPS near or below $3, i.e. a lost hyperscaler program, a failed 1.6T qualification or a capacity ramp that has stalled, rather than ordinary 139%-vol noise.

reasoning: Base rates first. From AAOI's own 2016-2026 monthly history (src 9) the unconditional 12-month forward return is extremely wide (10th/50th/90th pct about -63%/-5%/+454%, up in only 49% of months) and realised vol ~95-121%. Conditioning on a +100% trailing year gives three episodes: 2017 (every month followed by -27% to -62%), 2023-24 (mostly +10% to +110%) and 2025 (+300-475%); the late-2024 spike was followed by -35%. Trefis (src 10) counts 10 shocks with an average -44% peak-to-trough versus -14% for the S&P. The 2017 collapse (src 11,12) came from a single customer (Amazon, 55% of revenue) cutting orders right after a 10-bagger, and the 2000-02 optical bust (src 13,14) shows how fast component demand can halve. Against that, the current setup is stronger: Q2 revenue $191.9M (+86% y/y), Q3 guide $255-290M, FY26 ~$1.1B, $200M+ 1.6T orders and demand above capacity through mid-2027 (src 1,2,3), and the stock has already fallen ~50% from its $233.67 May high, partly on three equity raises (src 4,5). Macro and event markets are mostly benign for the horizon but not trivial: Kalshi 22% for a technical recession by Q4-2027 (src 15), Polymarket 7% for an 'AI bubble burst' in 2026 and 82.5% Nvidia still largest company at end-2026 (src 16,19), 95.75% no further Fed cuts in 2026 (src 18), 11% China invades Taiwan by end-2027 (src 17), and the Section 232 chip tariffs remain narrow with Taiwan given preferential terms (src 20,21). Valuation: at $115.59 AAOI is ~25x CY27 consensus EPS $4.60 (src 7); peer forward P/E median 37.7x but the closest product peers trade at 16-19x (src 8). My blended fair value is ~$106 (P/E $110, EV/EBITDA $101), close to spot, so valuation gives no strong tilt; the distribution is driven by scenario dispersion. I model a lognormal mixture: bear $40 (25%, sigma 0.5), base $108 (45%, sigma 0.33), bull $215 (30%, sigma 0.35). That gives a median just under spot (P(>=116)=0.48), a fat left tail consistent with AAOI's boom-bust record (P(<58)~21%) and a meaningful right tail (P(>=231)=13%), roughly matching a ~120-140% annual vol. Research limits: Twelve Data estimates/targets and Alpha Vantage were unavailable (plan/rate limits), so forward EV/EBITDA for peers is estimated, and the CY27 consensus is from a page last updated 2026-08-19.
